name: Graphical File Manager (GUI)
shortDesc: Desktop file explorer for browsing drives, network shares, and media files.
detailedDesc: Provides drag-and-drop file operations and thumbnail previews.

phase.title: Daily Apps & Productivity
phase.description: Web browsers, terminals, file managers (GUI and TUI), media viewers, notes, and local file sharing.

packages.name: Dolphin (Recommended)
packages.description: Feature-packed, fast Qt file manager from KDE with dual-pane browsing, integrated terminal panel, and Git status badges.

packages.name: Nautilus (GNOME Files)
packages.description: Clean, distraction-free GTK4 file manager with smooth animations.
cons: Fewer power-user split panel features than Dolphin

packages.name: Thunar
packages.description: Lightweight GTK3 file manager from Xfce with bulk renamer and custom actions.
